items.hook: Prince He of the First Rank, or simply Prince He, was the title of a princely peerage used in China during the Manchu-led Qing dynasty (1644–1912).
items.body: As the Prince He peerage was not awarded "iron-cap" status, this meant that each successive bearer of the title would normally start off with a title downgraded by one rank vis-à-vis that held by his predecessor. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.

items.hook: Poetic realism was a film movement in France of the 1930s.
items.body: More a tendency than a movement, poetic realism is not strongly unified like Soviet montage or French Impressionism but were individuals who created this lyrical style. One of those things you can't un-know.
